item.title: R150 000 fundraising milestone for slain DJ Warras' sons amid court proceedings
item.description: MORE than R150 000 has been raised through fundraising platform, BackaBuddy, for the trust of Warrick Stock's sons, aged 16, 14 and 11, following his murder on Reconciliation Day last month in the Johannesburg CBD. The fundraising has the support and consent of the Stock family. A suspect, Victor Majola, made a second appearance this week for the murder of the TV and radio personality.

item.title: Aussies 4-1 victory over England in the 25/26 Ashes Series
item.description: Australia chased down a target of 160 runs to clinch a 4-1 victory in the Ashes series against England. Jacob Bethell's remarkable innings of 154 set the tone, but it was the tense moments and pivotal wickets that kept fans on the edge of their seats as the Barmy Army rallied behind their team.

item.title: ‘They shot at police first’: Inside the KZN operation where five wanted suspects were shot dead
item.description: KwaZulu-Natal police are still combing the scene in the Bester area of Inanda, north of Durban, where five wanted suspects were shot and killed during a shootout in the early hours of Thursday.
